Container.Name: orca-slicer-api
Container.Overview: Optional OrcaSlicer companion for Bambuddy. Klipper support and pre-sliced G-code work without it; install this only for server-side slicing.
Container.Requires: amd64 host. In Bambuddy, enable Settings > Slicer > Use Slicer API and set the URL to http://YOUR-UNRAID-IP:3003.

Config.Name: API Port
Config.Description: Host port for the OrcaSlicer API. Bambuddy defaults to port 3003.

Config.Name: Persistent Data
Config.Description: Persistent slicer data and imported profile bundles.

Config.Name: Internal Port
Config.Description: Internal HTTP port. Do not change unless the image changes.
